ambient_quotient.reason: Z->C0 is regular etale H4, hence P->C0^2 is regular etale H4xH4 and quotienting first by H4_diag leaves a regular etale quotient of order 4

joint_map.degree_divisibility_from_ambient_cover: delta divides 4 because Y normalizes an irreducible curve in the regular H4-cover X->C0^2; the restriction degree is the stabilizer order of that curve under the ambient deck H4
joint_map.conclusion: j is birational onto Gamma; Y is the normalization of a genuine bidegree-(105,81) correspondence curve Gamma in C0 x C0

deck_consequence.generic_statement: the four H4 translates of the corresponding irreducible curve in X are distinct and each maps birationally to Gamma
deck_consequence.use: this converts the two-map problem from an arbitrary common factor problem into a primitive correspondence problem; any later common intermediate curve of degree 3 is excluded by the ambient H4 geometry

diagnostic_verdict.next_exact_route: use the primitive correspondence Gamma together with its four ambient H4 translates and the exact V6 pullback/intersection class; this can produce self-intersection or translate-intersection constraints stronger than the bare Rosati upper bound
